content.text:
The Cellar Door quest is finished and my notes are handed in.

I skipped the raiders and took the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom unseen. In the quartermaster's store I found jars of Hist sap tied with the Jal-Veesa tree-minder's knot, in a fort that has no Hist of its own. The gaoler, Tsleel-Vaku, wouldn't open the inner cellar door. Persuasion and the illusion spell both failed, and he said he carries no key. Never-Writes-Twice keeps it. Something moans behind that door, but I never learned who or what it is, or why the order feeds it sap.

The next step in the order's hunt is Bell Station, by boat from Lilmoth, to ask the divers which drowned spire the marker stone cuts deeper.
